questions.question: The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 58 years. Four years ago, the ratio of their ages was 4 : 1. What is the present age of the father?
questions.solution:
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Given: 

The present ages of a father and his son = 58 years 

Four years ago, the ratio of their ages = 4 : 1.

**Calculation:**

Let the present age of a father be (4x + 4) and the present age of a son be (x + 4)

According to the question,

The present age of a father and his son = 58 years 

⇒ (4x + 4) + (x + 4) = 58

⇒ 5x + 8 = 58

⇒ 5x = 50

⇒ x = 10

The present age of a father = (4x + 4) = 44 years

**∴ The present age of a father is 44 years.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** The logic followed here is :-

Sum of present ages of father and son = 58 years

Father + Son = 58 years .............. (i)

The ratio of ages 4 years ago is = 4 : 1

⇒ (Father - 4) / (Son - 4) = 4 / 1

⇒ Father - 4 = 4 × (Son - 4)

⇒ Father - 4 = 4Son - 16

⇒ Father = 4Son - 16 + 4

⇒ Father = 4Son - 12 ........... (ii)

By substituting equation (ii) in equation (i) we get,

⇒ 4Son - 12 + Son = 58

⇒ 5Son - 12 = 58

⇒ 5Son = 70

⇒ Son = 14

∴ Age of son = 14 years

∴ Age of Father = 58 - 14 = 44 years.

Hence, the correct answer is "44 years ".

questions.question: Inertia can be measured by its ________.
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Inertia can be measured by its mass.**
 
• **Mass is a measure of the inertia of the object, for an object, its inertia would depend on its mass.**
 
• **Inertia** is the property of an object by virtue of which it opposes any event that attempts to put the object in motion or to change its velocity.
 
• Therefore, an object at rest would want to continue staying at rest and an object in motion would have a tendency to continue its motion.
 
• The greater the mass of the object will be the tendency to resist the events.
 
• Hence, mass is a measure of the inertia of the object.
 
• **Newton's first law of motion:**
 
 
• It states that **"An object at rest stays at rest and an object in motion stays in motion with the same speed and in the same direction unless acted upon by an unbalanced force.**" Objects tend to "keep on doing what they're doing." In fact, it is the natural tendency of objects to resist changes in their state of motion. This tendency to resist changes in their **state of motion** is described as inertia.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Force:**

 
 
• The interaction that after applying to a body changes or try to change the state of motion or state of rest is called** force.**
 
• Force is denoted **by F and the SI unit is Newton (N).**
 
• **Force (F) = Mass (m) x acceleration (a).**
